blocks.title: Nucleic acids
blocks.text: Nucleic acids bare biomolecules hain jo genetic (virasati) information (maloomat) store karte aur aage transmit (muntaqil) karte hain. Yeh polymers hain jo nucleotides naam ki chhoti units se bante hain.

Nucleic acids nucleotide chains se bante hain jin mein sugar aur phosphate groups alternating (baari baari) aate hain, aur har sugar se aik organic (nitrogen wala) base jura hota hai. RNA mein sugar ribose hai aur DNA mein deoxyribose; dono ka ring paanch kone wala (five-membered) hai. Nucleotides sugar ke 5' aur 3' carbon atoms ke zariye phosphodiester linkage se jur kar nucleic acid banate hain (Figure 27.13). Yeh process kai million baar dohraya jata hai aur polynucleotide banta hai. Phosphodiester linkages mazboot covalent bonds hain, jo polynucleotide chain ko strength (mazbooti) aur stability dete hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: do nucleotides. 5' end par phosphate aik paanch atoms wali sugar ring ke 5' CH2 se jura hai jis par BASE hai; sugar ka 3' carbon O ke zariye doosre phosphate, phosphodiester linkage, se jura hai jo agli sugar aur base ke 5' CH2 se judta hai; woh sugar 3' OH par khatam hoti hai, chain ka 3' end. Daen: chain mein baari baari phosphate aur sugar, har sugar par base.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.13: Nucleic acids (DNA aur RNA) mein nucleotide chains ki general structure (aam banawat) (kitab ki Figure 27.13 ke mutabiq hamari drawing; jorne wala phosphate theek kiya gaya).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 5' aur 3' carbon ke number sugar ke hain. Aik nucleotide ke 3' carbon ki oxygen phosphate ke zariye agle nucleotide ke 5' CH₂ se jurti hai; yeh phosphodiester linkage hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.13 mein kitab ne jorne wale phosphate mein 3' carbon se aane wali oxygen ko P se double bond (P=O) se dikhaya hai. Asal mein yeh oxygen P se single bond se jurti hai, aur double bond aik alag (bahar wali) oxygen par hota hai. Hamari drawing mein sahi shakal dikhayi gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Nucleotide kin teen hisson se banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Phosphate group, paanch carbon wali sugar (ribose ya deoxyribose) aur nitrogen wala base.

items: Nucleic acids: nucleotides (phosphate + sugar + base) ke polymers; genetic information store aur transmit karte hain.
RNA mein ribose, DNA mein deoxyribose.
Sugar-phosphate backbone phosphodiester links (5' se 3') se juri hai.
